summary: psrp credentials: remote_user to log in as and remote_password (alias password), which can be supplied on the CLI.
questions: How do I set the username and password for psrp connections?

answer_card.title: psrp credentials
answer_card.answer_md:
- `remote_user`: user to log in as.
- `remote_password` (alias `password`): that user's password; can also be supplied as a CLI option.
